description: The values RayX's theme gave each role before the move to NSH's theme format, by role name, under each combination of colorMode, accent and density (os at its default). Recorded once from the theme.json theme_codegen.py wrote (the old cssVars format, read as the old reader read it): colors as #rrggbbaa, numbers in points, fonts as their family, a typography as its four parts. role_parity checks the new theme against it.
